Subject: Meridian Health — post-signing passoff + key acceptance anchors

Lauren / Monica —

Finalized deal MH (MER-2026-042) signed this morning. Quick summary for CS intake and to seed the kickoff:

- Contract: 12-month Hosted + Dedicated burst pool; SLOs: 99.9% uptime, p95 latency target 200ms for 512-token workload.
- Primary contacts (external): Anne Lopez (Prod Owner), Jamal Reyes (Infra / Net), Procurement.
- Acceptance anchors we agreed to with Meridian:
  1) Successful onboarding demo with sample dataset (anonymized) and end-to-end inference on dedicated pool.
  2) Latency verification run during peak pattern (simulated 1.2x expected qps) with <250ms p95.
  3) Security checklist complete (SOC2 questions answered + network allowlist completed).
  4) Data retention and logging settings validated with compliance team.

Attachments: SOW v3 + initial network notes (attached). Procurement will send PO next week.

Ask: Lauren, please capture a short acceptance checklist and nominate primary CS owner (will be handoff owner for first 90 days). Can we target kickoff next Wed or Thu (7/28-7/29)?

Thanks —
Ben

Subject: Re: Meridian Health — post-signing passoff + key acceptance anchors

Lauren / team — quick read on security items. I reviewed the questionnaire and the two outstanding items are: KMS integration pattern and HSM-backed signing for keys stored in customer's vault. Notes below: 

- KMS integration: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via our KMS connector. We'll need a short window during staging to verify key rotation and access policies. Expect ~2 hours of work from infra to verify IAM roles and a brief key import test.
- HSM: we support HSM-wrapped keys via standard PKCS#11 flows. For Meridian, Jamal will need to confirm whether their HSM supports remote wrapping or they prefer token-based import. If Jamal confirms remote wrap is supported, we can proceed without additional hardware motion.

Risks / blockers:
- If procurement delays PO beyond 7/24, kickoff will need to shift; our staging window is tight for July.
- Networking: Jamal — please confirm expected allowlist IPs and whether you require site-to-site VPN or simple IP allowlist.

I'll attach a short checklist (security_checklist.txt) to the drive folder and mark the remaining items.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Applied ML & Security — Redwood Inference
